acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a plumber for gas line installation, look for a licensed, insured, and experienced professional with expertise in gas fitting. Verify their local permits and ensure they are familiar with Las Vegas area codes and regulations. Check for positive customer reviews and transparent pricing.
